nuggets.text: The Wildcats' 71-3 win over Nicholls was the most points K-State has ever scored in a season opener.
Six different Wildcats ran for touchdowns against Nicholls, tying both the school and Big 12 records.
Brandon White returned his first career punt 65 yards for a touchdown against Nicholls.
Wildcats coach Collin Klein was K-State's quarterback and finished third in the 2012 Heisman Trophy voting.
Collin Klein's 27 rushing touchdowns in 2011 equaled the national record for a quarterback in a season.
Before becoming the Wildcats' star quarterback, Collin Klein played wide receiver for them in 2009.
Collin Klein and his wife, former K-State basketball player Shalin Spani, had their first kiss at the altar.
Asked to name the stadium for him, Bill Snyder said to name it after the people he cared about most: his family.
On Harley Day, more than 100 motorcycles parade around the field inside the Wildcats' stadium before the game.
The Wildcats' 1939 game against Nebraska was only the second college football game ever televised.
